newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: SocGen, Chase get Manila approval.
newsitem.headline: SocGen, Chase get Manila approval.

text.p: The Monetary Board said on Thursday it approved the applications of Chase Manhattan International Finance Ltd and Societe Generale to establish offshore banking units (OBUs) in the country.
Central Bank Governor Gabriel Singson said this will bring the number of OBUs operating in the country to 18.
An OBU can accept deposits from non-Philippine residents and extend loans in foreign currencies. It cannot transact business in pesos, nor accept or borrow from local residents.

Societe Generale, the largest private bank in France, had operated an OBU in the country from 1979 to 1992 until it decided to end its Manila operations as a result of allocation of priorities by its Paris headquarters, the statement said.
Chase Manhattan International Finance is a unit of The Chase Manhattan Bank of New York which merged with Chemical Banking Corp in July to become The Chase Manhattan Corp.
